name: ACP
description: Agent Client Protocol (ACP) host mode: run minimal-agent as an ACP agent over stdio, so editors (Zed, JetBrains, others) can drive it with no custom glue. Level 1: initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/cancel, text/thought streaming, tool-call and usage updates, basic stop-reason mapping.

hostModes.description: Agent Client Protocol v1 over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0 / NDJSON).
